header.title: Visitor arrivals by nationality/region
tablenote: For details on the classification of nationality/region, please refer to the monthly publication Visitor Arrival Statistics on the Hong Kong Tourism Board's website (https://partnernet.hktb.com/en/research_statistics/research_publications/index.html?id=3631).  The requirement for visitors to furnish an arrival or departure card is cancelled with immediate effect on 16 October 2024 as stipulated in Policy Address 2024, to facilitate a faster and more convenient immigration clearance.  “Place of residence” data derived solely from arrival cards is no longer available.  The classification method of this Web Table has been changed from by country/region of residence to by nationality/region.
Include Japan and South Korea only.
Include nationalities/regions in Asia and Indian Sub-Continent, except Japan, South Korea, Chinese Mainland, Taiwan, Macao and Hong Kong.
header.source: Hong Kong Tourism Board  For further information, please visit the website of the Hong Kong Tourism Board (www.partnernet.hktb.com).  (Enquiry telephone no. : 2807 6543  Enquiry e-mail : research@hktb.com)
